error: On the dashboard the PL and DE cards carry each other's labels; values and claim ids are untouched.
warning_texts: The swapped PL/DE labels on release/dashboard_data.json got through both release gates: release_surface_gate.json binds each number to its claim_id and never reads the card label a reader sees, and no rule in audit/check_plan.json compares a visible label with the claim behind it on any surface.

release/dashboard_data.json does not match the output of src/release/build_release.py, which builds the country labels from the claim_id, so the dashboard was changed after generation or came from a different generator than the one the release contract lists.

Both gate_release_document rules, claims_rendered and caveats_rendered, are listed under accepted_unproven in audit/check_plan.json because the plan proof failed with a missing-file error, so their 15 PASS results were never shown to fire on a broken release.
claims_rendered in gate_release_document covers release/report.md only; nothing checks that every claim reaches the dashboard.

The REC-COUNTRY-SUM and REC-REFUND-RATE reconciliations declared in audit/release_surface_contract.json leave no recorded result in audit/results/gate_release_machine/evidence; I recomputed both independently and both hold (35741.52 = 11181.67 + 11032.61 + 13527.24; 27/57 = 0.473684).

Only report.md tells the reader that the country figures add up to the headline; the dashboard has no such statement, so its reader can check the sum only by adding the cards by hand, under labels that are currently swapped.

The report line 'Numerator: 27 of 57' does not say what is being counted; only the caveat line above it, in the identifier-style wording 'unique paying_customers', says the unit is customers, and read on its own the line looks like an order count.

The spec's pinned period ends 2025-03-30, yet analysis/answers/R01.json and metrics period name '2025-Q1-delivered' call it the quarter; the release follows the spec, but whether 31 March is meant to be excluded is a question for the owner of audit_spec.yaml.
summary: Every business number on report.md, dashboard_data.json and the manifest recomputes exactly from raw_data/orders.csv (net 35741.52, PL 11181.67, DE 11032.61, CZ 13527.24, sum 35741.52, refund rate 27/57 = 0.473684 on paying customers), and all caveats are visible, but dashboard_data.json swaps the PL and DE card labels, so a dashboard reader sees PL 11,032.61 and DE 11,181.67 and both country figures are wrong for the label they sit under; both release gates passed this because they bind by claim_id, which the reader never sees.
